# How many employees does Perceptyx have?

Perceptyx, Inc. has approximately399 total employees worldwide as ofJune 2026, according to Revelio Labs workforce intelligence data.Perceptyx’s total headcount has grown0.8% from 396 employees in 2023 to 399 in 2026.

Data source: Revelio Labs•Coverage: Global workforce, 2023–2026•Published August 2026

## Is Perceptyx hiring right now?

Yes, Perceptyx isactively hiring. Perceptyx had10 active job postings in 2026, a 50.0% increase from 2025— [see job openings & hiring trends](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/perceptyx/employees#postings).

## About Perceptyx’s Workforce

Perceptyx, Inc. is an Information Technology Services company founded in 2003 and based in Temecula, California. It employs **399** people worldwide as of June 2026 and sits as the 10th-largest by headcount among its [peers](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/perceptyx/employees#similar-companies).

Perceptyx's workforce grew **0.8%** from 2023 to 2026, but it is down **2.9%** year over year in 2026. The headcount declined to a low of **352** in 2025 Q2 before recovering. Geographically, the workforce is concentrated in North America ( **75.3%**), followed by Northern Europe ( **9.9%**) and South America ( **8.7%**).

Perceptyx's groups are Finance and Operations ( **42.8%**), Engineering ( **31.9%**), and Sales and Marketing ( **25.3%**), with Engineering growth the fastest at **12.1%**. The average salary across all employees worldwide is **$134,914,** with regional medians of **$140,000** in North America and **$44,000** in South America, and compensation turning down **1.1%** year over year in 2026. Active postings rose **50%** in 2026 to **10**, while new postings per month have cooled from **21** in 2023 to **7** in 2026. Employee sentiment remains neutral but is trending downward.

Perceptyx's workforce is characterized by a distinctive arc: it fell and then recovered.
